rule_name: Full-Time Enrolment at CRICOS-Registered Institution Required
description: Applicant must be enrolled full-time in a CRICOS-registered course at a CRICOS-registered provider.
evidence_required: Valid CoE number from a CRICOS-registered provider
condition: Holds a valid CoE for a full-time CRICOS course
user_message_if_failed: You must be enrolled full-time at a CRICOS-registered institution. Verify provider AND course at cricos.teqsa.gov.au before paying any agent.

description: A valid Confirmation of Enrolment (CoE) is mandatory to lodge. An offer letter is not a CoE.
condition: Holds valid CoE(s) for all intended courses
user_message_if_failed: A valid CoE from a CRICOS provider is mandatory. Your application cannot proceed without it.

description: Since 23 March 2024 the GTE statement is replaced by the Genuine Student (GS) requirement, answered via specific questions in the application form (ties at home, reason for course/Australia, course-to-career benefit, and any other relevant circumstances).
evidence_required: Form answers + supporting evidence (ties, finances, study history)
condition: GS answers are specific, consistent, and evidence-backed
user_message_if_failed: Weak or generic GS answers are the leading refusal cause for Pakistani applicants. Be specific and consistent with your documents.

rule_name: Financial Capacity — Must Cover Tuition, Living Costs, Travel
description: Applicant must show genuine, accessible funds covering first-year tuition + AUD 29,710 (12-month single living cost, set May 2024) + return airfare (~AUD 2,500) + additional amounts per dependant. Pakistan is Assessment/Evidence Level 3 (from 8 Jan 2026): full source-of-funds documentation and ~3-month fund history expected.
evidence_required: Bank statements (3+ months), source-of-funds proof, sponsor income/FBR evidence, loan sanction or scholarship letters
condition: Funds >= tuition + living cost + airfare (+ dependants) AND genuine/traceable
user_message_if_failed: Insufficient or unexplained funds is a top refusal cause at EL3. Show tuition + AUD 29,710 + airfare, held consistently, with every major deposit documented. Verify the current living-cost figure before lodging.

description: Education and employment history should be consistent and logically connected to the chosen course; gaps over 12 months and drastic field changes must be justified. EL3 requires authenticated academic documents (HEC/IBCC attestation, certified translations).
applies_to: Applicants with gaps, field changes, or AL3 status
evidence_required: Transcripts/degrees (attested), employment letters covering gaps, GS justification
condition: Education path is consistent or any gap/switch is evidenced
user_message_if_failed: Unexplained gaps over a year or a drastic field switch will be probed. Provide attested transcripts and documented justification.

description: Overseas Student Health Cover from an approved Australian provider (Allianz, Bupa, Medibank, NIB, ahm) is mandatory for the full visa period, starting before course commencement.
evidence_required: OSHC policy certificate from an approved provider
condition: Active OSHC for full duration from an approved provider
user_message_if_failed: OSHC from an approved Australian provider is mandatory. Local/Pakistani insurance is not accepted.

description: A valid English test (IELTS/PTE/TOEFL iBT/Cambridge) is required unless exempt. Visa minimum is IELTS 5.5 overall (or equivalent); institutions commonly require 6.0-7.0.
evidence_required: Approved English test result meeting course + visa minimum
condition: Holds a valid result meeting both course and visa requirements
user_message_if_failed: A valid English result is required unless genuinely exempt. Meet BOTH the visa floor (IELTS 5.5) and your course requirement.

description: A health examination at an approved panel physician / Bupa Medical Visa Services is required; Pakistani applicants typically require a chest X-ray for TB screening. A HAP ID is generated in ImmiAccount to book it.
evidence_required: Completed medical at approved panel clinic, HAP ID
condition: Health exam completed at an approved panel physician
user_message_if_failed: A health exam at an APPROVED panel clinic is mandatory. Reports from unapproved local clinics are worthless for the visa.

description: Police clearances are required for Pakistan and any country lived in for 12+ months in the last 10 years. All character matters must be disclosed.
applies_to: All applicants (extra clearances if 12+ months abroad)
evidence_required: PCC from NADRA/police + foreign PCCs as applicable
condition: All required police clearances obtained; character disclosed
user_message_if_failed: Obtain police clearances for every country of 12+ months residence. Hiding character issues is an independent refusal ground.

rule_name: Course Must Be at the Same or Higher AQF Level (Condition 8202)
description: On a current student visa, you cannot move to a course at a lower AQF level without a new Subclass 500 (Condition 8202).
applies_to: Applicants changing course on an existing visa
condition: New course is at the same or higher AQF level
user_message_if_failed: Dropping to a lower AQF level on the same visa breaches Condition 8202 and risks cancellation.

description: The Subclass 500 visa application charge is approximately AUD 2,000 per primary applicant (increased 1 July 2025), separate from evidence-of-funds. Confirm the current charge before lodging.
condition: Able to pay the current application charge
user_message_if_failed: Ensure you can pay the ~AUD 2,000 charge at lodgement. This is separate from the funds you must show.

description: All prior visa refusals, cancellations, overstays, and asylum claims (any country) must be disclosed. Non-disclosure/misrepresentation is an independent refusal ground and can trigger a PIC 4020 three-year exclusion.
evidence_required: Full, accurate disclosure of immigration history
user_message_if_failed: Disclose every prior refusal/breach, even old ones. Concealment is fatal and can cause a re-entry ban.

rule_name: Work Limited to 48 Hours Per Fortnight During Study
description: Work is limited to 48 hours per fortnight while the course is in session (unlimited during scheduled breaks).
condition: Understands and will comply with the work limit
user_message_if_failed: Exceeding 48 hours/fortnight during study breaches your visa and risks cancellation.

rule_name: Must Maintain Full-Time Enrolment and Satisfactory Academic Progress
description: Must maintain full-time enrolment and satisfactory academic progress (Condition 8202).
user_message_if_failed: Failing to maintain full-time progress can lead to visa cancellation.

description: The applicant is legally responsible for all information submitted in their name, including by an agent. Fabricated documents (inflated balances, fake experience/transcripts) cause refusal and PIC 4020 bans regardless of who prepared them.
evidence_required: Personal verification of every submitted document
condition: Applicant has personally verified all submissions; agent reputable/registered
user_message_if_failed: Verify every document submitted in your name. Agent-fabricated content makes YOU liable for refusal and a possible 3-year ban.
